Fixed Stylus account-code-hash queries for nonexistent addresses to return zero, matching Nitro. Existing empty accounts still return the hash of empty code.

- Preserve account existence in local and forked state instead of synthesizing empty accounts for missing addresses.
- Add EVM/Stylus comparison coverage for account lifecycles, cold and warm reads, precompiles, delegation designators, snapshots, reverts, self-destruct, and address hashing.
- Update arbos-revm to v0.2.2.

Full changelog: https://github.com/iosiro/arbos-foundry/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2
